metadata.replay: All methods share recorded measurements. Estimator-dependent excitation and loop effects are omitted.
metadata.memory: All valid raw windows, six-tick updates; R=4*(sigma/k_hat)^2. R.make_filter constants and tempered IMM/EWA likelihoods; no tuning, no host centering or gates.
metadata.white_null: 8 deterministic independent Gaussian window-noise draws, conditional observed sigma/k_hat schedule, same filters; ignores overlap. Not posterior covariance.
metadata.counterfactual_order: noise off, depth-preserving u gauge, frozen endpoint local affine constitutive law, systematic remainder
metadata.freeze: Local affine tangent and Prony/viscous coefficients plus geometry/friction frozen to endpoint; original commands, initial state/history retained. A linearized intervention, not spatial freeze. Realized log-K range checked.
metadata.shares: mean absolute log contribution divided by sum; signed mean and RMS also stored. Interactions/order-dependent, not variance explained.
metadata.scoring: Exact col21 truth. SE masks; R transitions including small events. Event interval t0:t1+0.5, offsets previous0.5s, lag0:1.5s, settling tolerance0.1 for0.2s cap2s.
metadata.sampled_gain: Central difference of noise-free replays with +/-1um held-command20.8Hz sinusoid around original commands; 0.496s local harmonic+cubic fits, step0.248s. True axial F/encoder y. Does not change estimator observations. Nonstationary truth spans retained; not broadband control gain.
metadata.white_null_overlap: Also 24-tick moving-average white noise with the same marginal sigma/k_hat, preserving nominal overlap correlation. Eight fixed draws, finite-sample reference rather than exact Huber noise model.
metadata.systematic_gap: All requested e metrics use logged K. Separate per-episode measured sampled F/y gap and plateau errors relative to that measured gain are supplied; the gap is target-definition/systematic, not estimator error.
metadata.plateau_absence: Empty plateaus, phase bins and Allan scales remain missing; no substituted segments.
